source_tests: HumanEval+ (EvalPlus, Liu et al. 2023, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/evalplus/evalplus), HumanEval/2 from https://huggingface.co/datasets/evalplus/humanevalplus
statement: Given a non-negative floating-point number, return its fractional part: the number minus the largest whole number that does not exceed it. The result is always at least 0 and below 1.
